message:
The build succeeded. Now let me build with AddressSanitizer to test the PoC. Let me rebuild with ASAN enabled.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src && cmake -B build-asan -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DLIBICAL_JAVA_BINDINGS=False -DLIBICAL_GOBJECT_INTROSPECTION=False -DLIBICAL_GLIB=False -DLIBICAL_GLIB_BUILD_DOCS=False -DLIBICAL_DEVMODE_ADDRESS_SANITIZER=True 2>&1 | tail -5 && cmake --build build-asan -j4 2>&1 | tail -10'</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
